comments:
3ddfe82d: /**
 * Main entry point for the DGJXA15 routine.
 * This routine handles user input and validation for editing data in the VAS(393) file.
 */
de0b0a44: Call DE to initialize variables and check for existing data.
ed2bc80e: Set up variables for FILE, GLOBAL ROOT, FILE #, COMPUTED FIELDS, AUDIT TRAIL, USER LEVEL. Check if there is existing data.
7c592893: If there is a Date/Time field, extract the 7th piece and store it in DE(1).
6d217268: Clean up %Z variable.
4804636d: Write the field label and colon for the current field.
82563f70: Exit point after writing the field label.
9fc8c55d: Write the current field value and handle word-wrapping if needed.
e6738458: If the field is longer than 19 characters and it's a WORD-PROCESSING or COMPUTED field, branch to handle word-wrapping.
214c80a3: If the field is an INVISIBLE field and DE(DQ) is defined, display a "No Editing" message.
95f1e770: Read user input into X. If timeout, set DTOUT and X to U and beep.
1ce4c396: Exit point after reading user input.
3dca4c6e: Increment DQ and store it in DQ(DQ). DQ is a subscript used to store field values.
6cd2d575: Branch to the code for handling the current field value.
976d6514: If DE(DQ) exists, branch to validate the new field value. Otherwise, write the field label and read user input.
fa447663: Handle special cases for null input: if REQUIRED is not set, exit; if MULTIPLEFIELD, branch to validate the new value; if DATE/TIME field and input is null, exit.
28d8e453: If input starts with '?', branch to query help. If input starts with '^', call DIE17 to handle special lookups.
3d57ce93: If input is '@', call DIE2 to handle special commands.
19912040: If input is a space and the field is a DATE field with the SET VALUES property, and the user has a DEFAULT VALUE for this field, set X to the default value.

6a01fc72: Branch to validate input based on field type: M for Multiple-Field, V for Variable Pointer, S for Set of Codes. If it's a computed expression (12.1 node), evaluate it. Lookup data from the SET OF CODES.
ac4b34f7: If the SET OF CODES has multiple values, loop through them to find a match.
b2bb69df: If no match found in the SET OF CODES, display the external value and set X to the internal value.
c71316fe: If the field is a POINTER, set up DIC and call ^DIC to lookup the entry. If the lookup fails, exit.
089a09e3: If the field is a NUMBER and the input has more than 24 decimal places, kill X and branch to error trap.
a86151cc: Clean up input for NUMBER fields: remove leading zeroes, trailing decimal point, and adjust for Kernel $NUMBER format.
e11f22b6: Execute any computed code associated with the current field.
9c01366e: Store the new field value in DG(DW). If it's a DATE field, store the external value in ^DISV("DIE"). If input was U (user exit), exit. Otherwise, increment DQ for the next field.
9a578c81: If DB(DQ) is defined, go to the routine ^DIE17 at the label Z.
afd9a53e: Set X to the string '?BAD'.
6cf50f74: Set DZ to the value of X, execute the D and QQ^DIEQ routines, then go to the label B.

798be3c6: Set D to the value of DIFLD, set DQ(DQ) to the concatenation of DLB, DV, DU, DW, and the second to last pieces of the $TEXT function for the current MUMPS routine, separated by 'U' characters. Return.
6b446650: If DE(DQ) is not defined, execute the O routine. If X is not '@', go to RD. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', go to A. If X is '@', set X to Y and go to N.
362b8ee4: Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), and X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute it. Then go to RP.

a61b01e7: If DG contains 'P' and the global node specified by X_'0)' exists, set X to the second piece of that node. If the node specified by ^(Y,0) does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of ^(0), X to the third piece of the 0th node of the DD global for X, and DG to the second piece of ^(0). Then go to R.

6b0b89e2: If DG contains 'V' and Y is numeric, and the second piece of Y (delimited by ';') contains '(', and the global node specified by U_$P(Y,';',2)_'0)' exists, set X to the second piece of that node. If the node specified by ^(+Y,0) does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of ^(0). If the 0th node of the DD global for +X exists, set DG to the second piece and X to the third piece of that node. Then go to R.
169d9ed5: If DG contains 'D', execute ^DD('DD'). If DG contains 'S', set % to the second piece of X delimited by ';'_Y_':' and ';'. If % is not null, set Y to %.
3725537f: Execute the O routine. If X is null, set X to DE(DQ). If DV is null, go to A. If DC is less than 2, go to A. Otherwise, go to N^DIE17.
254e424f: If DV does not contain 'I' or '#', go to RD.
595b7501: Execute E^DIE0. If X is defined, go to RD. Otherwise, go to PR.
065303b4: Quit/return.
d7a2d897: Set DNM to 'DGJXA15' and DQ to 1.
b0983c12: Set DW to 'DT;7', DV to 'DX', DU to null, DLB to 'DATE REVIEWED', and DIFLD to 10.07.
7b7bd249: Go to the label RE.
ecc88bf3: Set %DT(0) to '-NOW', %DT to 'ETX', execute ^%DT, then kill %DT(0). Set X to Y, and if Y is less than 1, kill X.
8fbefdb9: Quit/return.
29256cbf: This section of code is handling field input validations for the VistA file #393.

e6a1ac45: This code checks if the entered date is after the DATE DICTATED field value for the current entry in file #393. If the entered date is earlier, it displays an error message and clears the DATE SIGNED field.
39fa1c77: End of the X2 label.
0f936dfd: This section of code is handling field input validations for field #3 in the VistA file #393.
c4a2a121: This code checks if field #3 is left blank. If so, it sets the DGJTST variable to 'SIGNED' and stores '@2' in the Y variable, which likely represents the internal entry number for field #3.
5e5dae8a: End of the X3 label.

5d250ecc: This code checks if the DG array is defined and its value is greater than 9. If true, it executes the F^DIE17 routine (likely a standard input transformation routine) and then transfers control to the ^DGJXA16 routine, which may handle further input processing or validation.
